en.t: Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, also accompanied the imperial procession.

units.source_text: 髭黑右大将神气十足，今日的装束也十分优美，身背箭囊，随侍在侧。

en.t: Higekuro, the Captain of the Right, looked full of confidence; his attire today was very elegant, and with a quiver on his back he attended at the emperor's side.

units.source_text: 此人肤色黝黑，髭须满脸，样子非常难看。

en.t: This man had a dark complexion and a face covered with a beard, making him look extremely unattractive.

units.source_text: 其实男子的相貌，怎么能同盛妆的女子相比较呢？

en.t: After all, how could a man's looks possibly compare with those of a woman in full finery?

units.source_text: 在男子中求美貌，真乃无理之事。

en.t: To look for beauty among men is truly an unreasonable thing to do.

units.source_text: 年轻的玉鬘看不起髭黑大将等人。

en.t: The young Tamakazura looked down on men such as General Higekuro.

units.source_text: 源氏打算送玉鬘入宫去当尚侍。

en.t: Genji intended to send Tamakazura to court to become a Naishi no Kami.
He had once asked her opinion about it.

units.source_text: 但玉鬘想道：“尚侍是怎么一回事呢？

en.t: But Tamakazura thought, "What exactly is a Naishi no Kami?

units.source_text: 入宫等事，我想也不曾想过。

en.t: Entering the palace and such things are matters I have never even thought about.
It would probably be very painful, would it not?"
She hesitated and would not agree.

units.source_text: 但今天看到了冷泉帝的相貌，她又想道：“

en.t: But today, after seeing Emperor Reizei's appearance, she thought again, "

units.source_text: 不要承宠，只当一个普通宫人，得侍御前，倒是很有意趣的吧。”

en.t: If I did not receive his favor, but served before him simply as an ordinary lady of the court, that might actually be rather interesting."
